_comment: Supply CAPABILITY for the TBox power tree -- nothing else. Topology (which converter feeds which rail) and loads (Load_mA fields) are read from the schematic by tools/power_model.py; tools/gen_power_tree.py draws the tree on the Power Tree sheet and writes the per-stage load notes on the Supply sheet; tools/check_power.py compares each rail's flattened load against max_ma. Per-node max_ma/max_basis is the supply's deliverable maximum (rated current, or the thermal limit where that binds first); _max_analysis records the derivation and is not drawn. alert_utilization is the fraction of max_ma at which check_power.py alerts. Optional per node: 'efficiency' + 'v' (switching stage: upstream current = I*Vout/(Vin*eff)), 'no_loads' (rail carries no DC load by design), 'sch_note_at'/'sch_note' (note placed on the Supply sheet; the generator prepends the measured load line).

input.name: 13V8_IN
input.note: SMBJ18A TVS after the filter (U1 max 35 V)

nodes.name: RAW_13V8
nodes._max_analysis: No conversion stage; capability is the input PTC hold current, shared with everything downstream (the +9V regulator's input current is its output current plus ~1 mA ground current).

nodes.name: +9V
nodes._max_analysis: Rated 1A but package-Pd-limited: Tj 125C, Ta 50C, thetaJA 32.5 C/W (RGW VQFN-20 with thermal pad on a ground pour with a via array -- a 2-layer board with a token pour is nearer 50 C/W, i.e. ~250 mA; VERIFY against layout) -> Pd 2.3W; at 15V in (6V drop) I <= 385 mA. At 13.8V in ~480 mA (PTC 0.5A then binds).
nodes.note: Pd <=1.5W @15V worst case; dropout 0.22 V, OK to 10V5 in

nodes.name: BIAS_5V
nodes._max_analysis: ADP7142AUJZ-5.0 rated 200 mA. Thermal is non-binding at this load: 9V in, 4V drop, load ~1-2 mA -> Pd ~8 mW, negligible in TSOT-23-5 (thetaJA ~170C/W).

nodes.name: VREF
nodes._max_analysis: OPA1678 output: 50 mA short-circuit; ~10 mA is a sane continuous drive limit for a DC bias reference.
nodes.no_loads: DC bias only: every gain-setting leg returns to GND
nodes.sch_note: DC bias only, no load by design
